title: South Pointe Park
description: Panoramic views of the South Beach shoreline, departing cruise ships and the downtown skyline, with a pier, splash pad and shaded lawns.

image.commonsTitle: File:South Pointe promenade.jpg
image.alt: South Pointe Park in South Beach, Miami, Florida

title: Wynwood Walls
description: The outdoor museum that turned Wynwood into a street-art destination. Ticketed inside the Walls; the surrounding neighbourhood murals are free to wander.

image.commonsTitle: File:Wynwood Walls Miami Florida October 2013.jpg
image.alt: Wynwood Walls in Wynwood, Miami, Florida

title: Puerto Sagua
description: Legendary no-frills Cuban diner on Collins Avenue serving huge plates of ropa vieja, Cuban sandwiches and cortaditos since 1962.

image.artist: David Berkowitz from New York, NY, USA
image.commonsTitle: File:Puerto Sagua Restaurant - Miami Beach Florida (4549452975).jpg
image.alt: Puerto Sagua in South Beach, Miami, Florida

title: Club Space
description: World-renowned electronic music club with a legendary open-air Terrace. The famous sunrise sets run well into Sunday morning; not for the faint of heart.

image.commonsTitle: File:SPACE TERRACE.jpg
image.alt: Club Space in Downtown, Miami, Florida

title: Ocean Drive & the Art Deco District
description: Neon lights and the world's largest concentration of Art Deco architecture. Unbeatable people-watching after dark without spending a dime.

image.commonsTitle: File:Ocean Drive in the Miami Beach Art Deco Historic District.jpg
image.alt: Ocean Drive & the Art Deco District in South Beach, Miami, Florida

title: Bayside Marketplace
description: Open-air waterfront marketplace with live music, food stalls and departing boat tours. Energetic in the evenings and free to walk through.

image.commonsTitle: File:Bayside305.jpg
image.alt: Bayside Marketplace in Downtown, Miami, Florida

title: Miami Beach Botanical Garden
description: A free three-acre urban oasis of native palms, orchids and a Japanese garden, tucked improbably behind the Convention Center.

image.commonsTitle: File:Pond at MBBG.JPG
image.alt: Miami Beach Botanical Garden in South Beach, Miami, Florida

title: Institute of Contemporary Art
description: Always-free contemporary art museum in the Design District, with a sculpture garden out back and consistently strong rotating installations.

image.commonsTitle: File:The Institute of Contemporary Art - Miami Design District (51010355042).jpg
image.alt: Institute of Contemporary Art in Design District, Miami, Florida

title: Metromover Skyline Ride
description: A completely free elevated people-mover looping Downtown and Brickell. The cheapest skyline tour in the city, with Biscayne Bay views.

image.commonsTitle: File:Miami Beach - Street scene, Spanish Village 01.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a street scene, standing in for Metromover Skyline Ride

title: Vizcaya Museum & Gardens
description: A 1916 Italianate villa on Biscayne Bay surrounded by formal European gardens. The most photogenic place in Miami and a National Historic Landmark.

image.commonsTitle: File:Coco Grove FL Vizcaya mansion01.jpg
image.alt: Vizcaya Museum & Gardens in Coconut Grove, Miami, Florida

title: Calle Ocho & Domino Park
description: Walk SW 8th Street past cigar rollers and fruit stands, and watch retirees play fierce dominoes at Maximo Gomez Park. Free and endlessly atmospheric.

image.commonsTitle: File:Little Havana Domino Club Park Calle Ocho.JPG
image.alt: Calle Ocho & Domino Park in Little Havana, Miami, Florida

title: Versailles Restaurant
description: The self-styled world's most famous Cuban restaurant, and the de facto town square of Miami's Cuban community. Order a cortadito at the walk-up window.

image.commonsTitle: File:Versailles Restaurant - Calle Ocho Miami.jpg
image.alt: Versailles Restaurant in Little Havana, Miami, Florida

title: Perez Art Museum Miami
description: Herzog & de Meuron-designed museum on the bay, with hanging gardens and a terrace that is worth the visit on its own.

price.detail: About $16 adult; free on second Saturdays

image.commonsTitle: File:PAMM MRD 23.jpg
image.alt: Perez Art Museum Miami in Downtown, Miami, Florida

title: Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Park
description: An 1825 lighthouse, a mile of calm beach and Stiltsville views at the southern tip of Key Biscayne. The best beach day near the city.

image.commonsTitle: File:SEA GRAPE (1-21-10) bill baggs state park, coral gables, fl -05 copy (4304268318).jpg
image.alt: Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Park in Key Biscayne, Miami, Florida

title: Mandolin Aegean Bistro
description: Greek and Turkish cooking served in the blue-and-white courtyard of a converted 1940s house in Buena Vista. Lunch outside is the move.

image.commonsTitle: File:Outdoor dining at night - Restaurant, St. Petersburg, Florida 2020.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a restaurant scene, standing in for Mandolin Aegean Bistro

title: Lincoln Road Mall
description: A mile-long pedestrian promenade of shops, cafes and street performers, designed by Morris Lapidus. Free, lively and shaded in parts.

image.commonsTitle: File:Steve Madden Lincoln Road Mall South Beach - exterior.jpg
image.alt: Lincoln Road Mall in South Beach, Miami, Florida

title: Joe's Stone Crab
description: A Miami institution since 1913. Stone crab claws in season (October to May), key lime pie year-round. The adjacent takeaway counter is far cheaper.

image.commonsTitle: File:Miami Beach - Joe's Stone Crab Restaurant 02.jpg
image.alt: Joe's Stone Crab in South Beach, Miami, Florida

title: Wynwood Brewing & Taproom Row
description: Miami's first craft brewery, anchoring a walkable strip of taprooms among the murals. Relaxed, dog-friendly and good before the clubs open.

image.commonsTitle: File:Taps on the bar, public bar, Railway Inn, Spofforth, North Yorkshire (16th January 2020).jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a brewery scene, standing in for Wynwood Brewing & Taproom Row

title: Oleta River State Park
description: Florida's largest urban park: mangrove kayaking, 15 miles of mountain-bike trails and a calm swimming lagoon.

image.commonsTitle: File:Miami FL Oleta River SP06.jpg
image.alt: Oleta River State Park in North Miami Beach, Miami, Florida

title: Time Out Market Miami
description: A curated food hall where a dozen of Miami's best chefs run stalls under one roof. The efficient way to eat well without a reservation.

image.commonsTitle: File:Outdoor dining at night - Restaurant, St. Petersburg, Florida 2020.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a restaurant scene, standing in for Time Out Market Miami

title: Ball & Chain
description: A 1935 Calle Ocho nightclub, reborn with live Cuban son and salsa on a pineapple-shaped stage. Mojitos and dancing, no pretension.

image.commonsTitle: File:April 7, 2015 - Little Havana, Miami, Florida - Ball & Chain & Ice Cream.jpg
image.alt: Ball & Chain in Little Havana, Miami, Florida

title: Zoo Miami
description: The only subtropical zoo in the continental US, so the animals are housed in open, cageless habitats. Vast; rent the tram in summer.

image.commonsTitle: File:Flamingos Miami MetroZoo.jpg
image.alt: Zoo Miami in South Dade, Miami, Florida

title: O-B House
description: Breakfast spot known for thick cast-iron baked pancakes and genuinely fresh ingredients. Expect a wait on weekends.

image.commonsTitle: File:S&S Diner, exterior, Miami Florida, August 2012.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a diner scene, standing in for O-B House

title: Riverwalk Fort Lauderdale
description: A mile and a half of brick promenade shaded by live oaks along the New River, linking the arts district to Las Olas. Free and lovely at sunset.

image.commonsTitle: File:Riverwalk, Fort Lauderdale, Florida,USA. - panoramio.jpg
image.alt: Riverwalk Fort Lauderdale in Downtown, Fort Lauderdale, Florida

title: El Camino
description: Bustling Las Olas taqueria with a 100-plus tequila list, strong margaritas and a late-night room that turns loud in a good way.
address: 817 East Las Olas Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, Florida, 33301

image.commonsTitle: File:Outdoor dining at night - Restaurant, St. Petersburg, Florida 2020.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a restaurant scene, standing in for El Camino

title: Museum of Discovery & Science
description: Hands-on exhibits, an otter habitat and a five-storey IMAX. The reliable rainy-day or too-hot-outside answer for families.

image.commonsTitle: File:Fort Lauderdale, Florida - Museum of Discovery and Science.jpg
image.alt: Museum of Discovery & Science in Downtown, Fort Lauderdale, Florida

title: Las Olas Boulevard
description: Fort Lauderdale's signature boulevard: galleries, boutiques and sidewalk cafes running from downtown to the beach. Free to stroll.
address: East Las Olas Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, Florida, 33301

image.commonsTitle: File:LasOlasBlvd.JPG
image.alt: Las Olas Boulevard in Las Olas, Fort Lauderdale, Florida

title: The Floridian
description: A 24-hour Las Olas institution since 1937, walls covered in photographs. Enormous classic diner breakfast at any hour, cash-friendly prices.

image.commonsTitle: File:Outdoor dining at night - Restaurant, St. Petersburg, Florida 2020.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a restaurant scene, standing in for The Floridian

title: Peter Pan Diner
description: Old-school Greek-American diner with huge portions, a rotating pie case and prices that have barely moved in a decade.
address: 1216 North Federal Highway, Fort Lauderdale, Florida, 33304

image.commonsTitle: File:S&S Diner, exterior, Miami Florida, August 2012.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a diner scene, standing in for Peter Pan Diner

title: Lester's Diner
description: Open 24 hours since 1967, famous for 14-ounce cups of coffee and an unchanged retro room. Cheap, comforting, and busiest at 3am.

image.commonsTitle: File:S&S Diner, exterior, Miami Florida, August 2012.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a diner scene, standing in for Lester's Diner

title: Fort Lauderdale Beach Promenade
description: Seven miles of sand behind the signature white wave wall, with a wide promenade for walking and skating. Free, with metered parking.
address: 551 North Fort Lauderdale Beach Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, Florida, 33304

image.commonsTitle: File:Miami Beach - Ocean Palm Motel.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a beach scene, standing in for Fort Lauderdale Beach Promenade

title: Hugh Taylor Birch State Park
description: 180 acres of rare maritime hammock wedged between the Intracoastal and the beach, with a freshwater lagoon and a tunnel to the sand.

image.commonsTitle: File:Hugh Taylor Birch State Park.jpg
image.alt: Hugh Taylor Birch State Park in Sunrise, Fort Lauderdale, Florida

title: Bonnet House Museum & Gardens
description: An eccentric 1920s plantation-style home on 35 acres of subtropical grounds, complete with resident squirrel monkeys and orchid houses.

image.commonsTitle: File:Bonnet House Museum & Gardens (Fort Lauderdale, Florida) 002.jpg
image.alt: Bonnet House Museum & Gardens in Sunrise, Fort Lauderdale, Florida

title: Fort Lauderdale Water Taxi
description: Hop-on hop-off boats threading the canals that earned the city its Venice of America name, with narration on the mansions and megayachts.
address: 1 East Las Olas Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, Florida, 33301

image.commonsTitle: File:Water Taxi (Fort Lauderdale, Florida) 1.jpg
image.alt: Fort Lauderdale Water Taxi in Downtown, Fort Lauderdale, Florida

title: Coconuts
description: Waterfront deck where boats pull up alongside your table. Fish tacos, cold beer and the most reliably pleasant afternoon in the city.

image.commonsTitle: File:Outdoor dining at night - Restaurant, St. Petersburg, Florida 2020.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a restaurant scene, standing in for Coconuts

title: Himmarshee Village Bar Strip
description: Two blocks of bars and live-music rooms off SW 2nd Street. The centre of downtown nightlife, busiest Thursday through Saturday.

image.commonsTitle: File:Seated inside at a table at Melt N Dip Crepe & Gelato in Temple Terrace, Florida, US, on 23 June 2026.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a nightlife scene, standing in for Himmarshee Village Bar Strip

title: Anglin's Fishing Pier & Lauderdale-by-the-Sea
description: A walkable old-Florida beach village with a historic pier and shore-accessible reef snorkelling right off the sand.

price.detail: Free to walk the village and beach

image.commonsTitle: File:Lauderdale by the Sea Florida Fishing Pier 07.jpg
image.alt: Anglin's Fishing Pier & Lauderdale-by-the-Sea in Lauderdale-by-the-Sea, Fort Lauderdale, Florida

title: FATVillage & Flagler Village Arts District
description: Warehouse arts district of studios, murals and breweries just north of downtown. Best on the last-Saturday art walk.

image.commonsTitle: File:April 7, 2015 - Little Havana, Miami, Florida - Calle Ocho Cigar Shop.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a art scene, standing in for FATVillage & Flagler Village Arts District

title: Sistrunk Marketplace & Brewery
description: A 30,000 square-foot food hall and brewery in a restored warehouse, with a dozen kitchens, a stage and a sizeable beer garden.

image.commonsTitle: File:Outdoor dining at night - Restaurant, St. Petersburg, Florida 2020.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a restaurant scene, standing in for Sistrunk Marketplace & Brewery

title: Gumbo Limbo Nature Center
description: Free nature centre with a boardwalk through coastal hammock, saltwater tanks and a sea-turtle rehabilitation facility.
address: 1801 North Ocean Boulevard, Boca Raton, Florida, 33432

image.commonsTitle: File:Gumbo limbo PARK florida.jpg
image.alt: Gumbo Limbo Nature Center in Boca Raton, Fort Lauderdale, Florida

title: Stranahan House Museum
description: The oldest surviving structure in Broward County, an 1901 trading post on the New River, shown by guided tour only.
address: South Federal Highway, Fort Lauderdale, Florida, 33301

image.commonsTitle: File:Fort Lauderdale-Stranahan House-waterside.jpg
image.alt: Stranahan House Museum in Las Olas, Fort Lauderdale, Florida

title: Disney Springs
description: Vast waterside dining, shopping and entertainment complex. Free to enter and free to park, which makes it the best no-ticket Disney evening.

image.commonsTitle: File:Disney Springs (23169700192).jpg
image.alt: Disney Springs in Lake Buena Vista, Orlando, Florida

title: Lake Eola Park
description: Downtown Orlando's centrepiece: a lake ringed by a one-mile path, the famous swan boats, and a fountain that lights up after dark.

price.detail: Free; swan boats about $18 per half hour

image.commonsTitle: File:Lake-eola-park-orlando-florida.jpg
image.alt: Lake Eola Park in Downtown, Orlando, Florida

title: Se7en Bites
description: Southern comfort bakery famous for towering biscuit breakfasts, the Minnie Pearl cake and pie that justifies the queue.

image.commonsTitle: File:Outdoor dining at night - Restaurant, St. Petersburg, Florida 2020.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a restaurant scene, standing in for Se7en Bites

title: Universal CityWalk
description: Restaurants, bars and live music immediately outside the Universal gates. No park ticket required, though parking is paid before 6pm.

image.commonsTitle: File:Universal CityWalk Orlando 2008.jpg
image.alt: Universal CityWalk in Universal, Orlando, Florida

title: Wall Street Plaza
description: Seven themed bars sharing one open-air downtown courtyard, with block parties spilling across the street at weekends.

image.commonsTitle: File:Wall Street Plaza Downtown Orlando.jpg
image.alt: Wall Street Plaza in Downtown, Orlando, Florida

title: Old Town Kissimmee
description: Retro walking district of classic-car cruises, old-fashioned shops and a vintage midway. Free to enter, delightfully kitsch.

image.commonsTitle: File:Old Town, Orlando 03.JPG
image.alt: Old Town Kissimmee in Kissimmee, Orlando, Florida

title: Audubon Park Garden District
description: A genuinely local strip of makers, vintage shops, a co-op grocery and East End Market. Best during the Wednesday evening market.

image.commonsTitle: File:Miami Beach - Street scene, Spanish Village 01.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a street scene, standing in for Audubon Park Garden District

title: Harry P. Leu Gardens
description: Fifty acres of camellias, roses and one of the largest formal rose gardens in the Southeast, on the shore of Lake Rowena.

image.commonsTitle: File:Orlando Mizell-Leu House Hist Dist01.jpg
image.alt: Harry P. Leu Gardens in Audubon Park, Orlando, Florida

title: Winter Park Scenic Boat Tour
description: A one-hour pontoon tour through the canals linking Winter Park's lakes, past lakefront estates and Rollins College. Running since 1938.
address: 312 East Morse Boulevard, Winter Park, Florida, 32789

image.commonsTitle: File:Centennial Park In West Palm Beach Florida water fountain with colored lights for the Christmas Holidays.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a park scene, standing in for Winter Park Scenic Boat Tour

title: Park Avenue, Winter Park
description: Brick-paved avenue of boutiques and sidewalk cafes facing Central Park, with the Morse Museum's Tiffany glass collection at the north end.

image.commonsTitle: File:April 7, 2015 - Little Havana, Miami, Florida - Calle Ocho Cigar Shop.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a art scene, standing in for Park Avenue, Winter Park

title: East End Market
description: A neighbourhood food hub of small-batch vendors, a bakery, a fishmonger and Domu's ramen counter. Where Orlando's food scene actually lives.

image.commonsTitle: File:Outdoor dining at night - Restaurant, St. Petersburg, Florida 2020.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a restaurant scene, standing in for East End Market

title: Black Rooster Taqueria
description: Small Mills 50 taqueria doing scratch tortillas and bright, careful salsas. Cheap, fast and consistently the best tacos downtown.

image.commonsTitle: File:Outdoor dining at night - Restaurant, St. Petersburg, Florida 2020.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a restaurant scene, standing in for Black Rooster Taqueria

title: Mills 50 District
description: Orlando's Vietnamese and creative quarter: pho counters, bubble tea, murals and dive bars, all walkable and refreshingly untouristed.

image.commonsTitle: File:April 7, 2015 - Little Havana, Miami, Florida - Calle Ocho Cigar Shop.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a art scene, standing in for Mills 50 District

title: Kraft Azalea Garden
description: A quiet free lakeside garden of cypress and azaleas on Lake Maitland, with a marble exedra that is a local sunset ritual.

image.commonsTitle: File:Centennial Park In West Palm Beach Florida water fountain with colored lights for the Christmas Holidays.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a park scene, standing in for Kraft Azalea Garden

title: Orlando Science Center
description: Four floors of hands-on exhibits, a dinosaur hall and a giant-screen theatre. The city's best indoor option for kids on a wet afternoon.

image.commonsTitle: File:Orlando Science Center.jpg
image.alt: Orlando Science Center in Loch Haven, Orlando, Florida

title: Wekiwa Springs State Park
description: A 72-degree natural spring you can swim in year-round, with canoe rentals and 13 miles of trails half an hour from downtown.

image.commonsTitle: File:Centennial Park In West Palm Beach Florida water fountain with colored lights for the Christmas Holidays.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a park scene, standing in for Wekiwa Springs State Park

title: Morse Museum of American Art
description: The world's most comprehensive Louis Comfort Tiffany collection, including the restored chapel interior from the 1893 World's Fair.
address: 445 North Park Avenue, Winter Park, Florida, 32789

image.commonsTitle: File:Charles Hosmer Morse Museum of American Art (Winter Park, Florida) 001.jpg
image.alt: Morse Museum of American Art in Winter Park, Orlando, Florida

title: ICON Park
description: Open-air complex on I-Drive anchored by a 400-foot observation wheel. Free to enter and walk; individual attractions ticketed.

image.commonsTitle: File:Miami Beach - Street scene, Spanish Village 01.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a street scene, standing in for ICON Park

title: Hourglass District
description: A compact neighbourhood of breweries, a bottle shop and good pizza in a once-overlooked corner of Orlando. Low-key and local.

image.commonsTitle: File:Taps on the bar, public bar, Railway Inn, Spofforth, North Yorkshire (16th January 2020).jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a brewery scene, standing in for Hourglass District

title: Dr. Phillips Center for the Performing Arts
description: Downtown's Broadway touring house and concert venue, with a free-to-use plaza and frequent outdoor programming.

image.commonsTitle: File:Dr. Phillips Center Pics 03.jpg
image.alt: Dr. Phillips Center for the Performing Arts in Downtown, Orlando, Florida

title: Gatorland
description: The self-declared Alligator Capital of the World, open since 1949. Unpolished, genuinely old-Florida, and far better value than the big parks.
address: 14501 South Orange Blossom Trail, Orlando, Florida, 32837

image.artist: The original uploader was Bobak at English Wikipedia.
image.commonsTitle: File:Gatorland entrance -Florida-23Feb2006.jpg
image.alt: Gatorland in South Orlando, Orlando, Florida

title: The Ravenous Pig
description: The gastropub that kicked off Orlando's independent food scene. House charcuterie, a serious beer programme and a famous burger.

image.commonsTitle: File:Outdoor dining at night - Restaurant, St. Petersburg, Florida 2020.jpg
image.alt: A representative photograph of a restaurant scene, standing in for The Ravenous Pig
